question: How are the tremor and ear elements proportioned in this configuration?
premises: One part is assigned to a tremor element.
An ear element may be two parts.
Another tremor element is placed on one side.
inference: The configuration uses one-part and side tremors with a two-part ear element.
uncertainties: The spatial relation implied by ekataḥ is not fully explicit.
plain_english: There may be a tremor of one part, an ear of two parts, and a tremor on one side.
